title: A calmer stage: fitting motions, faster scripts, a progress bar and a Close button
description: Avatar Show stops decorating ordinary talk with stunts, the Playwright gets its own fast model, script writing shows progress, and the panel says Close in words.
highlights: Motions only where they fit: the Playwright keeps a motion for what a character is literally doing (a bow, a wave, a dance while dancing) and never uses one as emphasis for talk. The heart gesture and walk clips are off the stage. Lines without a motion get natural talking hands or a shift of stance.

The Playwright has its own model (Settings › Reasoning › Avatar Show script writer): OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna by default, so a script no longer waits a minute or two on an agent runtime such as EnConvo. Choose “Same as my reasoning provider” to keep the old behaviour.

Script writing shows an estimated progress bar with percent and time left, learned from how long your last scripts took. What you tell the Director about length (“very short”) now beats the Length menu.
A Close button in the Avatar Show header when no show is running: it saves any recording and returns to one character, like the × light.
From 0.2.24: a flourish look wider than a narrow window is no longer cut off, and a character no longer comes up holding an empty pistol grip.
